sources.name: CHGIS Temporal Gazetteer, historical placenames at 262 CE
Historical Basemaps by André Ourednik and contributors, Han 200 CE

limitations: The perimeter is an approximate 200 CE Han-era geographic frame, not a verified 262 CE three-kingdom border.
Each game territory is generated around a historical place. It is not a historical county/commandery boundary.
Familiar city labels sometimes designate a commandery seat; exact site matches remain a planning approximation where marked.
No modern province boundaries, mountain relief, rivers, or terrain combat modifiers are shown.
